name: POLYFORGE Asset Pipeline
description: Generate an original low-poly mesh, canonicalize it into a stable-ID editable asset, evaluate non-destructive typed geometry nodes, bake strict budgeted LODs with measured GLB readback, and hand those levels to the runtime distance selector.

components.role: canonical editable source and stable-ID operations
non-destructive typed geometry DAG and deterministic evaluation
offline LOD generation, GLB export, and readback

connections.note: The generated mesh initializes the canonical editable document.
A source.asset node can consume the current canonical revision without embedding it.
Only validated graph-evaluated source revisions are baked.
Runtime selection consumes measured levels, not authoring estimates.

acceptanceCriteria: Identical graph and source inputs produce identical canonical source, evaluation traces, and GLB bytes.
Geometry graphs reject cycles, unknown sockets, incompatible types, and multiple inbound links before evaluation.
Every generated family respects targetFaceCount or fails explicitly.
Every descriptor triangle and byte count is independently read from exported GLB data.
LOD triangle counts are non-increasing and never exceed their declared budgets.
Stable-ID split and extrusion edits preserve manifold closed source meshes.
